customManagers.description: The yt-dlp release scripts/desktop.mjs ships with the desktop app

packageRules.description: Node stays on 24 until 26 is tested. This covers the node image, node-version in setup-node (looked up as actions/node-versions), .nvmrc, engines and @types/node.
GitHub Actions: auto-merge all updates once every check is green; main has no required checks, so GitHub's own auto-merge would not wait for them
Go: group minor, patch and digest module updates into one weekly PR that merges once CI is green; majors stay separate for review. dependency-fixups.yml tidies desktop/go.mod on the branch
npm: group minor and patch into one weekly PR that merges once CI is green; majors stay separate. dependency-fixups.yml rebuilds web/dist on the branch
The Expo SDK decides React, React Native and the native modules in mobile/; npx expo install --fix moves them with an SDK upgrade
A new Expo SDK gets a PR of its own, never merged automatically, so the rest of mobile/ can follow it by hand
prBodyNotes: Run `npx expo install --fix` in `mobile/` on this branch and commit the result, so React, React Native and the `expo-*` modules move to this SDK's versions.

packageRules.description: Override for xcode, which loads uuid with require(); 12 and later are ESM only
The Expo module build files declare no repositories and get Google's Maven from the app at build time, so Renovate would only ask Maven Central, which has no androidx
gVisor's master branch is laid out for Bazel and go build rejects it (two packages in one directory); only its go branch builds, so gvisor stays on the last commit that does
The desktop module points at the main module through a replace directive, so its version is never read
React Native's Android build expects JDK 17
The compose file is for people to copy, so it follows the app's own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale every build
